python -c "
from semver import VersionInfo, replace, createparser, main, process

print('=== R1: Immutability ===')
v = VersionInfo(1, 2, 3)
for attr in ['major', 'minor', 'patch', 'prerelease', 'build']:
    try:
        setattr(v, attr, 99)
        print(f'FAIL: {attr} should be immutable')
    except AttributeError:
        print(f'PASS: {attr} is immutable')

# Check no new attributes can be set
try:
    v.new_attr = 'test'
    print('FAIL: new attribute should not be allowed')
except AttributeError:
    print('PASS: no new attributes allowed')

print()
print('=== R2: Iteration ===')
v = VersionInfo(1, 2, 3, 'alpha', 'build')
result = list(v)
expected = [1, 2, 3, 'alpha', 'build']
print(f'Iteration result: {result}')
print(f'Matches expected: {result == expected}')

print()
print('=== R3: Tuple comparison ===')
v = VersionInfo(1, 2, 3, 'alpha', 'build')
print(f'eq tuple: {v == (1, 2, 3, \"alpha\", \"build\")}')
print(f'lt tuple: {v < (2, 0, 0, None, None)}')
print(f'gt tuple: {v > (1, 0, 0, None, None)}')
print(f'le tuple: {v <= (1, 2, 3, \"alpha\", \"build\")}')
print(f'ge tuple: {v >= (1, 2, 3, \"alpha\", \"build\")}')
print(f'ne tuple: {v != (1, 2, 3, \"beta\", \"build\")}')
print(f'eq string (should be False): {v == \"1.2.3\"}')
print(f'eq int (should be False): {v == 123}')

print()
print('=== R4: Bump methods ===')
v = VersionInfo(1, 2, 3, 'alpha', 'build')
print(f'bump_major: {v.bump_major()}')
print(f'bump_minor: {v.bump_minor()}')
print(f'bump_patch: {v.bump_patch()}')
print(f'bump_prerelease: {v.bump_prerelease()}')
print(f'bump_build: {v.bump_build()}')

print()
print('=== R5: Type conversion ===')
v = VersionInfo('1', '2', '3', 123, 456)
print(f'major type: {type(v.major).__name__}, value: {v.major}')
print(f'minor type: {type(v.minor).__name__}, value: {v.minor}')
print(f'patch type: {type(v.patch).__name__}, value: {v.patch}')
print(f'prerelease type: {type(v.prerelease).__name__ if v.prerelease else \"NoneType\"}, value: {v.prerelease}')
print(f'build type: {type(v.build).__name__ if v.build else \"NoneType\"}, value: {v.build}')

print()
print('=== R6: CLI functions ===')
print(f'createparser exists: {callable(createparser)}')
print(f'main exists: {callable(main)}')
print(f'process exists: {callable(process)}')

print()
print('=== R7: Replace ===')
print(f'Module replace(\"1.2.3\", minor=5): {replace(\"1.2.3\", minor=5)}')
v = VersionInfo(1, 2, 3, 'alpha', 'build')
print(f'Method replace(minor=5): {v.replace(minor=5)}')
"
